title: Live check with a real saved recipe
goal: The owner recalls a recipe and a scaled quantity
acceptance: The agent saves one recipe, recalls it, asks for a scaled quantity and checks the working
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner
Anything that needs a human sense, account or device goes back to the owner as its own step

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner jobs case study, before design. Not a measurement. Moved to the agent 2026-11-18 (0.25 h owner → agent).
